tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ra we/ pha dran pas snying gi gdung ba sel/ /pha dran pas 'dod dgu lhun gyis grub/ /pha dran pas gnyug ma'i rang sa zin/ /pha dran chog rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gdams ngag tshig gsum gyi gtam snyan 'di/ /rna bar ta kun la 'phrod mod kyi/ /lag len du thebs pa dkon par 'dug /dad ldan gyi slob ma'i yid la zhig /so sod 'gol 'dod kyi dben gnas de/ /yun ring po rtag thub dka' bas na/ /grong yul gyi 'du 'dzil ma chags par/ /snying nas ri khrod 'grim pa gces/ /dka' spyad kyi zhe rus sad sud de/ /bzang rdzu'i ngang la 'dun pa yal/ /snang sems dbyer med 'dres kyi bar/ /sred zhen gyi 'ching ba rgyang thag srings/ /'khri ba kun rtsad nas ma chod na/ /zhen log tu re yang rang nyid bslu/ /'dod yon kha yan du spyod spyod nas/ /tshig lta skad mtho yang 'khor bar 'khyams/ /phyogs 'dzin dang zhan pa'i mos gus dang*/ kha drag dang 'jigs skyob kyi dad pa 'di/ /steng 'grus kyis khyer nas rtag mi thub/ /thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres pa gcig 'tshal/ /gnas pa lteng po cig rkyen mi thub/ /rnam rtog rang ga ma 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /go yul dang yin snyam gyi nam phugs bslu/ /'gyur ba 'gyu stong gi ngang du zhog /rang rgyud la lta zhing rang sems 'dul/ /rtag tu rang sems la rang gros thob/ /rlom sems su ma byed rang 'tshang drus/ /blo brtsis btab med pa'i dbyings su skyol/ /da rtag tu bla ma la gsol ba thob/ /chags sdang gi rnam rtog la 'bur 'joms gyis/ /zhen chags kyi 'khri ba rbad kyis chod/ /chos sgra bo che de mthar phyin yong*/ /rig pa gang shar gyi rang 'gros la/ /dgag sgrub kyi bdag rkyen ma byed ang*/ /phyi ltas su shor na rang la sdig /bya byed ye med kyi ngang la skyur/ /nyams len gyi gnad bskul cung zad 'di/ /bu slob ma'i sems la gros 'debs yin/ /gtad med kyi rig pa'i rang mdangs tsam/

/nges med kyi kha nas shor ta thal/ /rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā thas mthing stod sgom chen bka' rgyud rgyal mtshan la smras pa'o// //༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rigs kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /rang sems chos skur ngo sprod pa'i/ /pha mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu khyed la dran bskul tshig gsum smra/ /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i mi lus la/ /rtag 'dzin gyi 'dun gros ma shom ang*/ /pho rgod po shom ra rgya che yang*/ /bya byed kun shul du bzhag nas 'gro/ /bu 'jig rten gyi blo rgya ma skyed par/ /chos nyams len la blo sna sgyur bar 'tshal/ /dus lan cig byed snyam ngang ring po/ /phyi shol gyi ngang la lus nyen gdog /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di rgal bar dka'/ /le lo dang snyoms las kyis mi 'grub pas/ /nyin mtshan du dran pa'i lcag gis bskul/ / sems lang shor la 'phral du 'jur thag thong*/ /sgra brag cha'i dbyangs 'dis bslu bslu 'dra/ /grags 'dod kyi phye 'thor ma 'gam shig /gtam mi zer la brtsis btab ma byed par/ /rang thag chod kyi shes pas sgom la 'bungs/ / gnas dben pa'i ri khrod nyams bag bde/ /'phral sdig dang ma 'dres 'tsho ba bsten/ khong nor shed dang dbang thang gi nga rgyal can/ /'phral mi rtag pa'i rang 'tshang bstan nas bslu/ /bu 'dod chung chog shes la blo rtse gtod/ /lar 'dod yon gyi 'khri ba 'di spyad dka' yang*/ /don snying po med pa'i tshul la soms/ / blo yid brtan gyi gdeng thub chos las med/ /dam tshig rang srog las gces par srungs/ /mos gus la ltem 'gyang med pa dang*/ /gdung shugs kyi gsol 'debs rgyun mi 'chad/ /nyams len la steng 'grus med par 'tshal/ /rang shar gyi rig pa so ma 'di/ /bzo bcos med par rang sar zhog /rang 'gros la spang blang ma byed par/ /gang shar rang grol du lhug par zhog /spyod lam dang rnam g.yeng gang byed kyang*/ /gang shar la thug phrad ngo shes kyis/

/rang sar bzhag pas lhod kyis grol/ /ci dgar bskyur la cham me zhog /lar snang ba sna tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di/ /snang tsam ma gtogs don la med/ /nang rig pa dbyings su gdod nas zhi/ /cir yang ma grub rang rig tsam/ khyed lta ba'i dgongs pa de la mdzod/ /gang shar la bcas bcos ma byed par/ /gnas sam 'gyu'am ci 'dra yang*/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rang so zung*/ /yengs med kyi dran pa sten skad kyang*/ / dran bya dang dran byed dbyings su stor/ khyed sgom pa'i gnad don de la mdzod/ / las 'bras la yid ches dad pa skyed/ /'khor ba la ma chags nges 'byung 'phrul/ /ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la snying rje'i rtsal/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi bla ma bsten/ /dge ba ci byed gzhan don du bsngo/ khyed spyod pa dgos na de la mdzod/ /gzhi gdod ma nas bzhugs pa'i chos sku de/ /ye grol dang ye rdzogs su bzhugs mod kyang*/ /de ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams pa de/ /nam 'phel 'grib med pa'i don rtogs na/ /skyon sgrib gnyis rang sar grol ba yin/ khyed 'bras bu bzhed na de tsug lags/ /da sgrub pa nyams su longs pa dang*/ /rang sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par smon/ /rang rgyud grol ba mthar phyin nas/ / gzhan rgyud smin grol byed par shog /ces pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas bso thog nang so ngag dbang phun tshogs la gdams pa'o/ /bkra shis// //༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ mos ldan thar pa'i lam la 'dren mdzad/ / mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la btud nas/ /rang nyid nyams len sgrub la g.yel kyang*/ /gzhan la snying gros 'di skad 'debs so/ /mi lus lan cig thob res 'di la/ /g.yeng ma lam la mi tshe zad na/ /phyi nas chos dang mjal ba'ang dkon pas/ /god kha de las che ba med do/ /byis par yod 'phro dar mar 'gro zhing*/ / dar ma yin 'phral rgas pas sleb dang*/ /phal cher rgas long med par 'chi bas/ /long yod byed sa yod snyam gda' ye/ /rgas rgas sdod pa'i dbang du byas kyang*/

/sang dang snangs zhes drangs pas zla ba/ /zla gcig zla gnyis ngang la lor sleb/ /lo shas drangs pas ma chor ba la/ /rgas par sleb nas 'chi la thug 'gro/ /za rgyu 'thung rgyu 'gro 'dug cig dang*/ /gnyid dang gtam gyi zar zir cig la/ /byas rjes 'di yin med par zad 'gro/ /longs spyod ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra la/ /lang tsho rtswa rtse'i zil pa dang mtshungs/ /dus ni ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du/ /sdod pa'i gnas med 'di la soms dang*/ /mi zhig nyal ba'i rmi lam gsal por/ /yid 'ong dga' ba'i grogs dang 'grogs nas/ /glu len dga' ston bde skyid myong yang*/ /sad tshe gar song cha med yal ba/ /rmi lam de la chags pas gdungs shing*/ /yal ba de la sdug bsngal byed pa/ /'khrul snang tsam la spang blang byed pa'i/ /mi de shin tu blun pa yin no/ /da lta'i grogs dang longs spyod dgra gnyen/ /thams cad 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam la/ /blo yi dga' sdug bcos pa ma gtogs/ /gnas lugs don la grub pa med do/ /gzhan yang dga' ba skyed pa'i yul 'di/ /gtan gyi bde bar blo gtad mi thub/ /lo zla zhag 'ga'i 'dun ma yin pas/ /rtag rtsis ma byed chos la 'bungs dang*/ /rang la gzhan gyis 'char kha zer ram/ /'dod don bgegs dang gnod pa byed na'ang*/ /sngon dus bsags pa'i las ngan 'bras bu/ /ci rigs smin pa'i rnam smin byung gi /gzhan la tshig za zhe sdang spongs dang*/ /dge sbyor skul ma yin par shes nas/ /sdig pa kun la bshags pa 'bul zhing*/ /dge ba tshogs gsog gang 'grub gyis shig /rang 'dod can gyi mi ngan khyod la/ /rang gis nyes pa'i rnam smin byung gi /zol zog khyod la 'di rang mkho zhes/ /rang gis rang la zhe khrel gdab bo/ /rang nyid dge sbyor byed pa'i dus su/ /mdza' ba'i grogs dang gnyen gyi gdung sems/ /sgom khang la sun zad med long gtam/ /'di bzhi bdud du che bas spongs shig /tshe 'di mi rtag yad yud yin zhing*/

/bla ma slob ma dpon g.yog dgra gnyen/ /yul phyogs khang khyim nor rdzas kun yang*/ /yad yud tsam gyi 'brel pa yin no/ /'chi ba'i dus su dam chos min pa/ /rang la phan pa'i bya ba med cing*/ /gzhan la phan pa'i thabs kyang med pas/ /rang gzhan kun phyir nyams len gyis shig /'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes sam/ /brgya byin thob kyang tha mar ltung bas/ /rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal/ /yin pas thar pa thob thabs gyis shig /mkha' khyab sems can snying la bcangs nas/ /nyams len gzhan don kho nar bsgril dang*/ /da lta dngos su phan ma thogs kyang*/ /phugs su gzhan phan de rang che'o/ /ri khrod dben par nyams len byas nas/ /nyams myong 'phral du 'char bar 'dod na/ /zhag shas snying rus drag tu bkyed dang*/ /de nas brtson 'grus shugs la 'byung ngo*/ /dang po stan thog tshugs pa cig dang*/ /gnyis pa lus gnad bsrangs su 'jug cing*/ /skyo na dran pas 'phral du sleb pa/ /de kha'i ngang la zungs thub dgos so/ /spyil bu man mun rang rod can la/ /dang ma chags par skyid skyid mo dang*/ / spro spro rig pa dngas dngas mo zhig /dgos na dge sbyor g.yeng ba'i rtags yin/ /ltogs 'khyags byung na sran bkyed thub pa/ /mun khung nang du blo bag 'bebs mkhan/ /blo sna mi mang chig 'dril byed pa/ /de la nyams myong 'phral du skye'o/ /las 'bras spang blang khyad du gsod pa'i/ /chos pa'i ming btags dmyal ba'i mchong stegs/ /dam tshig bzhi mdo'i rtsa bzhin 'dor ba'i/ /sgom chen bstan pa'i chom rkun yin no/ /des na dge sdig blang dor zhib la/ /dam tshig srog bzhin gces par gzung nas/ /nges 'byung snying rjes skul ma 'debs shing*/ /mos gus lam gyi rtsa bar zungs shig /'di tsam dran 'dzin skul ma yin pas/ /yang yang dran cing sems la bzhog las/ /sgos dus phan pa'i gdams ngag 'di ni/ /'phral 'phral lag len thebs par gyis shig
/ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas badzra lā sya zhes bya ba'i dad la gdams pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/zhal gdams thor buu bzhugs/ PAGE 8- - PAGE 5- -- PAGE 4 -
